claims.title: Exact pointwise minimum of the scalar relaxation
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: P_* satisfies S1-S3 and every positive profile satisfying S1-S3 lies pointwise above it.
dependencies: OAI26 scalar assumptions; its h_a recurrence is prior work
claims.limitations: Only the specified scalar relaxation. No actual tensor character realizing P_* is constructed. No priority claim.

claims.title: Compatibility with the rank upper bound
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.limitations: Feasibility at t=3/4 is not a lower bound on the unrestricted matrix multiplication exponent.

claims.title: Compatibility with replication
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: P_*(qa,qb)^3 >= q^4 P_*(a,b)^3 for positive integers q,a,b.
claims.limitations: Does not assert compatibility with every inequality in UZ26.

claims.title: Necessary source length for identical matched sectors
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: A single C(a,B) with three identical C(a,b) targets sharing the a-dimensional input requires B >= 3b+a-1.
claims.limitations: Only the stated identical-sector and single-source class. It does not rule out unequal blocks or tensor-product sources.

claims.title: Product-convolution filtration inequalities
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: The determinant filtration of C(a,b) tensor C(c,d) yields the three stated matched-sector inequality families.
dependencies: OAI26 shared-leg entropy; classical determinant filtration
claims.limitations: Logical independence from the initial scalar system is not proved. No novelty claim for determinant filtration.

claims.title: Uniform tripling gain implies an exponent improvement
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: If every relevant character has a uniform eta>0 gain at all sufficiently large scales, omega <= 9/(4+2 eta).
dependencies: OAI26 spectral conversion and rank bound
claims.limitations: The premise is open. The numerical example 1500/667 is not an established exponent bound.

claims.title: Scalar-profile finite and symbolic checks
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 73,856 exact grid assertions and four symbolic identities pass.
claims.limitations: The finite grid does not prove the general theorem.

claims.title: Finite product-filtration search
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 353,664 inequalities over 20,736 source quadruples with a,b,c,d <=12 produce no violation of P_*.
claims.limitations: Historical finite experiment; the later AI-FILTRATION-007 supplies a separate written all-size compatibility proof.

claims.title: Finite monomial-weight searches
claims.origin: ChatGPT session directed by repository owner
claims.statement: 12,976 binary, 209,692 ternary, and 20,000 seeded random candidates produce no scored violation.
claims.limitations: Unknown blocks use a slice lower bound. Random candidates need not be distinct. Floating display rankings are not certificates.

claims.title: All-size equivalence of fixed-label product filtration and concavity through zero
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: For positive symmetric F with F(1,b)=b, the three fixed-label two-source determinant-filtration families are equivalent to separate concavity through the zero boundary. P_* satisfies all three families at every positive integer quadruple.
dependencies: OAI26 character rules for the application to actual profiles
claims.limitations: Only the stated three families. No coupled-fiber or oriented-character exclusion, historical priority, independent review, or exponent improvement.

claims.title: Full scaling limit and nonsmooth critical rigidity
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: Positive symmetric separately concave profiles satisfying replication with degree d and the matching rank upper bound have the full homogeneous scaling limit. Shifted tripling implies d>=4/3; at equality the limit is K min(x,y)^(1/3)(max(x,y)+min(x,y)/2), without an assumed diagonal derivative.
dependencies: UZ26 replication degeneration; earlier oriented rescaling is attributed
claims.limitations: Completion of an earlier local draft using attributed external constructions. No tensor character at equality is constructed or excluded; no independent review or exponent improvement.

claims.title: Conditional limiting-curvature improvement with analytic bridge supplied
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: If every relevant character has normalized limiting curvature delta(F)>=delta_0>0 for the same constant, then omega<=9/(4(1+delta_0)). Scaling and one-sided derivative arguments supply the earlier draft analytic premises.
claims.limitations: No positive curvature constant or endpoint character exclusion is proved. The example 2250/1001 is conditional, not an exponent bound.

claims.title: Conditional all-degree fat-point construction threshold
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: Degenerations from C(a,B_a,k) to T_a tensor B_X(k) at asymptotic cost rho imply rho*d*(d+1)*2^d>=8 for every relevant d=1/t. Any fixed rho<9/(7*2^(1/3)) yields a smaller exponent. Cost one would imply omega<=125/56.
dependencies: Concurrent Koszul worker degree-three fat-point target
claims.limitations: No required convolution-source degeneration is constructed. The displayed rational exponent is solely conditional. No independent review or Lean formalization.

claims.title: Arbitrary exact-restriction cost barrier for canonical fat-point targets
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: A constant linear restriction C(A,B) to T_a tensor B_X(k), sharing the first source input, requires B>=k*a^2-A+1. If A/(k*N_a) tends to zero, its asymptotic source cost is at least two.
dependencies: Elementary slice rank under injective domain restriction and codomain projection
claims.limitations: Exact restrictions only. Matrix rank can drop under singular degeneration, so the border construction remains open. Arbitrary unrelated block identifications are outside the stated target.
